item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
What's new

  • New Friends tab: share your friend code or add a friend's. When a friend starts a focus round, their pet comes over to your screen and works at its own desk next to yours.
  • Click a friend's name tag to join their round, so you both finish at the same time.
  • Step away during a focus round and your pet tells your friends. Meanwhile the pets on your screen play together until you're back.
